mil1:2.1: Milindo nāma so rājā Sāgalāyam-puruttame upagañchi Nāgasenaṃ, Gangā va yatha sāgaraṃ.
mil1:3.1: Asajja rājā citrakathiṃ ukkādhāraṃ tamonudaṃ apucchi nipuṇe pañhe ṭhānāṭhānagate puthū.
mil1:4.1: Pucchāvissajjanā c' eva gambhīratthūpanissitā hadayangamā kaṇṇasukhā abbhutā lomahaṃsanā.
mil1:5.1: Abhidhammavinayogāḷhā suttajālasamatthitā Nāgasenakathā citrā opammehi nayehi ca.
mil1:6.1: Tattha ñāṇaṃ paṇidhāya hāsayitvāna mānasaṃ suṇotha nipuṇe pañhe kankhāṭhānavidālane ti.
mil1:7.1: Taṃyathā 'nusūyate.- Atthi Yonakānaṃ nānāpuṭabhedanaṃ Sāgalan-nāma nagaram nadī-pabbata-sobhitaṃ ramaṇīya-bhūmippadesabhāgaṃ ārām-uyyānopavana-taḷāka-pokkharaṇī-sampannaṃ nadī-pabbata-vana-rāmaṇeyyakaṃ sutavantanimmitaṃ nihata-paccatthika-paccāmittaṃ anupapīḷitaṃ vividha-vicitra-daḷha-m-aṭṭāla-koṭṭakaṃ varapavara-gopuratoraṇaṃ gambhīraparikhā-paṇḍarapākāra-parikkhittantepuraṃ suvibhatta-vīthi-caccara-catukka-singhāṭakaṃ suppasāritānekavidha-varabhaṇdaparipūritantarāpaṇaṃ vividha-dānagga-sata-samupasobhitaṃ Himagirisikharasankāsa-varabhavanasatasahassa-patimaṇḍitaṃ gaja-haya-ratha-patti-samākulaṃ abhirūpanaranāri-gaṇānucaritaṃ ākiṇṇa-janamanussaṃ puthu-khattiya-brāhmaṇa-vessa-suddaṃ vividha-samanabrāhmaṇasabhājana-sanghaṭitaṃ bahuvidhavijjāvanta-naravīra-nisevitaṃ Kāsika-koṭumbarakādi-nānāvidha-vatthāpaṇa-sampannaṃ suppasārita-rucira-bahuvidha-pupphagandhāpaṇagandhagandhitaṃ āsiṃsaniya-bahuratana-paripūritaṃ disāmukha-suppasāritāpaṇa-singāravāṇijagaṇānucaritaṃ kahāpaṇa-rajata-suvaṇṇa-kaṃsa-patthara-paripūraṃ pajjotamāna-nidhi-niketaṃ pahūta-dhanadhañña-vittūpakaraṇaṃ paripuṇṇa-kosakoṭṭhāgāraṃ bahv-annapānaṃ bahuvidha-khajja-bhojja-leyya-peyya-sāyaniyaṃ Uttarakurusankāsaṃ sampannasassaṃ Aḷakamandā viya devapuraṃ.
mil1:8.1: Ettha ṭhatvā tesaṃ pubbakammaṃ kathetabbaṃ, kathentena ca chaddhā vibhajitvā kathetabbaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ: Pubbayogo, Milindapañhaṃ, Lakkhaṇapañhaṃ, Meṇḍakapañhaṃ, Anumānapañhaṃ, Opammakathāpañhan ti.
mil1:9.1: Tattha Milindapañho: Lakkhaṇapañho Vimaticchedanapañho ti duvidho; Meṇḍakapañho pi: Mahāvaggo Yogikathāpañho ti duvidho.
